result.summary: A narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides, lined with row houses and mature trees. Parallel parking on both sides provides a physical buffer between the walkway and the single travel lane.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb create visual barriers between drivers and pedestrians who might step into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Add vertical traffic calming measures to maintain low vehicle speeds in this residential area.

result.summary: This is a narrow residential street lined with brick row houses and on-street parallel parking. The sidewalk is present but constrained by building steps and decorative planters, creating a narrow effective walking path for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Narrow effective sidewalk width
hazards.description: Steps and planters encroaching on the sidewalk reduce the clear path for pedestrians, especially those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the building frontages on the left side of the image.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: High-profile vehicles parked along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and right side of the image where cars are parked.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Increase the width of the sidewalk to provide a consistent clear path that accommodates both building access (steps) and pedestrian movement.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or mid-block points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow urban residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides and parallel parking. While the narrow roadway likely encourages low vehicle speeds, the environment lacks marked pedestrian crossings and features significant visibility obstructions due to parked cars.

hazards.name: Visibility Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along both sides of the street create significant blind spots for both drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkways
hazards.description: The sidewalks are relatively narrow, which may force pedestrians into the roadway when encountering others or small obstructions.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low on this residential street.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with buildings directly abutting the sidewalk. A prominent garage entrance and a protruding basement hatch create potential conflicts and obstructions for pedestrians in an otherwise continuous walkway.

hazards.name: Basement Hatch Obstruction
hazards.description: A raised blue basement hatch protrudes into the walking path, creating a trip hazard and narrowing the effective sidewalk width.
hazards.location_in_image: Lower left, in front of the brick building.

hazards.name: Vehicle Access Point
hazards.description: A large garage door indicates a point where vehicles cross the sidewalk, creating potential conflict with pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center, the dark grey garage door.

interventions.title: Flush Basement Access
interventions.description: Replace the protruding basement hatch with a heavy-duty cover that is flush with the sidewalk surface to eliminate the trip hazard.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Greenery
interventions.description: Install planters or additional street trees to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.
